description: As Alaska communities continue to suffer the consequences of declining fisheries, today lifelong Alaskan and former fishing boat captain Mary Peltola announced her plan to restore abundance to Alaska fisheries and protect the fishermen, families, and communities they sustain.

title: Mary Peltola Announces Plan to Fight for Alaska Fisheries - Mary Peltola
